other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
The applicant must be registered under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Madhya Pradesh and have an active membership at the time of application.
Dependents are eligible if they are aged 16 to 45 years.
The scheme is only for building/construction workers and their dependents.
benefits_summary: The scheme provides free skill training to construction workers and their dependents.
